turn.rationale: Run already owns one immutable Intent/Plan; no conversation or repeated planning invariant requires Turn

action.definition: Durable logical operation record compiled from one Plan step, distinct from an execution attempt and from authorization
action.creation_boundary: Explicit admission after revalidated Approved/v5 and BOUND_V1 exact contextual Plan identity match; no automatic creation; LEGACY_UNBOUND denied

cardinality.mvp: 0 before admission or for legacy unbound approval; exactly 1 for the complete new exact-bound append_service_note/1 Plan; reject unsupported whole Plans

action.versioning: Independent CAS: creation v1, authorization v2, claim v3, outcome/recovery v4; future evidence-only resolution v5; no Run.version mutation
action.attempts: One durable attempt per Action in MVP; no retry edge

compilation.input: Server-loaded Approved Run/Plan + valid decision/history + retained BOUND_V1 companion matching content/context + trusted catalog/registry
rules: ADR-014 canonical-plan-v1 and approval-plan-v1 verify retained approval-time content/context before compiler or receipt replay; no legacy rebinding
Whole Plan must contain only append_service_note/1 SIDE_EFFECT for service-demo
SHA-256 spec binds Plan/step/arguments/target/risk/Run version/decision/derived approval binding/compiler/executable binding/scope
Reject stored mismatch or stronger/changed policy; never repair silently

authorization.boundary: Verified PrincipalContext -> deny-by-default AuthorizationPort -> exact-spec permission record; fresh execute permission check
authorization.mvp_principal: One privately provisioned local bearer capability mapped to stable server-owned local-demo subject and fixed scope; no human/distinct-approver claim
authorization.missing_verifier_or_grant: DENY; no permissive fixture in product
authorization.current_policy: No hot policy update or renewal in MVP; stale/revoked authority cannot claim; prior owner must drain/stop before reconfiguration

execution.explicit_command: Separate authorize and POST /api/actions/{action_id}/execute, expected_action_version + Idempotency-Key + verified Authorization header
execution.unknown_outcome: Unknown when dispatch/result/local commit cannot establish the effect
execution.claim_model: Action state/version CAS + unique durable attempt_id, no automatic expiry/lease takeover
execution.dispatch_permission: Only confirmed winning claim commit; unconfirmed claim commit yields no adapter invocation
execution.transaction_model: short gate claim transaction -> one external call -> short gate result transaction
execution.timing_limit: No hard disk/OS fault or physical cancellation guarantee
execution.delivery_semantics: At most one gateway dispatch opportunity per Action in supported single-owner scope; local once-only state edge != exactly-once external effect; no at-least-once liveness guarantee

control_plane.generated_by: Caller UUIDv4 persisted before each logical command
control_plane.exact_replay: Fresh authentication/visibility then receipt lookup before CAS; return current snapshot/replayed=true; no grant/attempt/event/dispatch

external_side_effect.stable_namespace: Persist in Action and external store metadata; never a per-startup/deployment suffix

tool_boundary.metadata_catalog: Existing non-callable trusted proposal definitions unchanged
tool_boundary.executor_port: Immutable ExecutionSpec + effect key + attempt_id + bounded context; no raw Run/HTTP/gate DB/credential or state mutation
tool_boundary.demo_resource: Explicitly provisioned isolated separate SQLite note/receipt store; effect+receipt atomic inside external store only; no gate ATTACH/cross-store atomicity claim

crash_windows.observation: Authorized before claim or Executing after committed claim but before call
crash_windows.reconciliation: Required for claimed branch; unclaimed fresh explicit execute may pass

crash_windows.observation: External success may exist, local result absent/uncertain
crash_windows.reconciliation: Receipt proof may support future Succeeded

crash_windows.observation: External confirmed-failure response lost before local commit
Local Succeeded/result/event/command receipt committed; HTTP response lost
crash_windows.recovery: Unchanged; same-key replay/GET reads current result

persistence.migration: Explicit offline upgrade after quiescence and consistent v1 backup; atomic new schema/indexes/user_version=2; no destructive reset/automatic startup repair
persistence.v1_validator: Default strict v1 still rejects 2; future v2 composition explicitly selects validated v2 contract
persistence.rollback: Frozen code + consistent pre-migration v1 backup; no blind version decrement/drop
persistence.approval_binding_authority: ADR-014: one insert-only companion per decision, BOUND_V1 contextual digest or LEGACY_UNBOUND with null proof
persistence.legacy_admission: DENY for MVP; no historical hash fabrication; distinct v2 Run/new approval
persistence.new_v2_decisions: APPROVE and REJECT bind atomically with existing decision/Run/audit, preserving external API and v1 DDL
persistence.binding_validation: Known revision/content/context checked on bound v2 reads/startup, admission/replay and later exact-spec gates

decisions.decision: NO; Run + Action
decisions.rationale: A Run already identifies one immutable Intent/Plan; no conversation or repeated planning invariant needs Turn.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Run + Turn + Action; execution fields on Run
decisions.consequences: Turn is deferred; Action cannot mutate the frozen Run lifecycle.

decisions.decision: Durable identity for one compiled Plan-step operation; attempts are separate facts.
decisions.rationale: A logical effect must outlive requests and process attempts.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Action-as-HTTP-request; Action-as-attempt
decisions.consequences: One Action keeps one stable effect identity and independently records execution truth.

decisions.decision: Explicit POST /api/runs/{run_id}/actions after Approved and verified BOUND_V1 exact Plan identity; no execution.
decisions.rationale: Admission is separate from planning, approval, authorization and dispatch.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: During planning; at validation/routing/approval automatically
decisions.consequences: Only an exact-bound reloaded approved Plan can supply an Action; legacy approval is denied and replay never bypasses proof.

decisions.decision: Model 0..N, one per admitted step; MVP accepts exactly one append_service_note step.
decisions.rationale: The frozen Plan supports multiple steps, but sequencing is not needed for this MVP.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: One Action per Run regardless of steps; partial admission of unsupported Plans
decisions.consequences: No Actions before admission; multi-step/read/APPROVAL_REQUIRED execution is rejected as a whole.

decisions.decision: Pending, Authorized, Executing, Succeeded, Failed, Unknown
decisions.rationale: Separate recorded permission and dispatch; preserve uncertain effects.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Run states; treating timeout as Failed; extra scheduling states
decisions.consequences: Unknown is non-executable and requires evidence for any future resolution.

decisions.decision: Independent Action CAS, starting at 1; each state mutation +1.
decisions.rationale: Execution concurrency must not change Run.version.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Reuse Run CAS; timestamp ordering; last-write-wins
decisions.consequences: Admission, authorization, claim and completion have their own guards.

decisions.decision: Trusted compiler after ADR-014 content/context approval digest verification; no rebinding.
decisions.rationale: Current valid Plan and Approved state alone do not prove what was approved.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Copy client/model JSON directly into an executor; hash legacy current Plan as historical proof
decisions.consequences: Canonicalization preserves all Plan content; missing/legacy/mismatched proof and stronger policy reject.

decisions.decision: Verified PrincipalContext + deny-by-default AuthorizationPort; bound authorization record and fresh claim check.
decisions.rationale: LOCAL_USER and Approved establish no authenticated permissions.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Approve means permission; body actor fields; permissive test authorizer in production
decisions.consequences: MVP permits one private local execution capability and fixed demo scope; full user/RBAC consent is deferred.

decisions.decision: Separate authorize then explicit execute with expected_action_version and Idempotency-Key.
decisions.rationale: An operator must request dispatch independently of approval.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Approval webhook auto-dispatch; execute embedded in Run creation
decisions.consequences: No model call or implicit tool call occurs in admission or authorization.

decisions.decision: Durable scoped command receipts; stable server effect_key and persisted execution_scope per Action.
decisions.rationale: A repeated request and a repeated external effect have different identities.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Process cache; model IDs; regenerate effect key for each request
decisions.consequences: Duplicates map to prior accepted work; different Runs remain distinct intentional operations.

decisions.decision: No automatic execution retry; MVP one attempt per Action.
decisions.rationale: Even a timeout or lost local result can hide a completed effect.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Generic exception retry; retry Unknown as Failed
decisions.consequences: Future retry needs provider contract, unchanged key/payload, quiescence, fresh authority and reviewed new attempt semantics.

decisions.decision: Unknown after uncertain dispatch/result/commit; no inferred success or failure.
decisions.rationale: Gate DB and external effect do not share one transaction.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Assume rollback means no remote effect; timeout equals failure
decisions.consequences: Future evidence-bound reconciliation may resolve Unknown, never blindly resend.

decisions.decision: ToolExecutor receives immutable ExecutionSpec, effect identity and bounded attempt context.
decisions.rationale: The adapter needs effect data, not control-plane mutation powers.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Raw Run, HTTP Request, gate DB connection, arbitrary callable
decisions.consequences: Only the gateway invokes the selected adapter; outcomes are SUCCESS, CONFIRMED_FAILURE or UNKNOWN_OUTCOME.

decisions.decision: Separate metadata catalog and explicit server-owned executable registry.
decisions.rationale: Metadata acceptance must not grant executable capability.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Catalog insertion automatically registers execution; dynamic imports
decisions.consequences: Only append_service_note/1 has an MVP binding to the isolated demo adapter.

decisions.decision: Short admission/grant/claim/result transactions with paired facts; external call between claim and result.
decisions.rationale: A local DB cannot atomically commit an external side effect.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: DB lock across tool I/O; cross-file atomic-effect claim
decisions.consequences: Result-persistence failure leaves uncertainty and lookup handles, never automatic replay.

decisions.decision: Action state/version CAS + one durable attempt_id; no expiring lease.
decisions.rationale: One app owner needs one winning dispatch, not takeover machinery.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Lease expiry; background worker; process lock alone
decisions.consequences: Only confirmed winning claim receives a dispatch permit; old completions are fenced.

decisions.decision: Validate ledger; Executing -> Unknown once; all other states unchanged.
decisions.rationale: Startup cannot prove whether a committed claim sent an effect.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Replay pending/claimed work; query tools at startup
decisions.consequences: Recovery remains deterministic/model-free/tool-free and requires stopped predecessor.

decisions.decision: Separate action_events and durable command/authorization/attempt facts.
decisions.rationale: Day 2 audit schema and version chain are frozen.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Overload Run audit payloads; diagnostic logs as execution truth
decisions.consequences: Each Action mutation pairs one event; accepted execution request is recorded atomically with claim.

decisions.decision: Explicit offline atomic v1 -> v2 migration; preserve v1 rows/DDL; add five Action tables and approval_plan_bindings.
decisions.rationale: Action and exact approval evidence cannot be hidden in frozen Run tables.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Reset DB; automatic startup migration; fabricate legacy digests; weaken v1 validation
decisions.consequences: Nine-table v2 mode is explicit; legacy decisions remain unbound; rollback requires a consistent v1 backup.

decisions.decision: Five APIs: Action admission/list/detail/authorize/execute; no public retry/reconcile API in MVP.
decisions.rationale: Separate creation and permission make the boundary inspectable; reads support lost-response lookup.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: GET that creates Actions; unnecessary generic update or scheduler APIs
decisions.consequences: Strict bodies, safe envelopes, CAS and scoped idempotency apply only to new commands.

decisions.decision: One local operator capability, one approved single-step SIDE_EFFECT Plan, one demo note adapter and one attempt.
decisions.rationale: This proves the gate/effect crash boundary without full platform machinery.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Multi-tool, APPROVAL_REQUIRED execution, Turn, cloud/MCP/HA
decisions.consequences: Full authenticated distinct consent, multi-step execution and reconciliation remain future gates.

p2: Full user identity/RBAC and authenticated distinct consent/expiry; APPROVAL_REQUIRED execution stays disabled
